candidates.denominator: ATUS respondent diary-day total for the mapped activity
candidates.mapping: atus-2025-action-mapping-v1: Proxy estimate from ATUS tier-one 05 work episodes
candidates.reasoning: Weighted ATUS occurrence durations supply a related-activity estimate; the source does not directly identify this action outcome.
assumptions: Each diary episode is weighted by the respondent final survey weight TUFINLWGT.
The fitted minimum and maximum are the weighted 5th and 95th percentiles.
The fitted median is the weighted 50th percentile.
The triangular shape approximates the three fitted quantiles.
ATUS records work time but does not classify whether its outcome was good or bad.
The action crosswalk is versioned as atus-2025-action-mapping-v1.
The mapped diary activity is related to the action but does not directly measure it.
Multiple mapped episodes for one respondent are summed across the diary day.

limitations: These are empirical sensitivity bands rather than replicate-weight confidence intervals.
ATUS covers the United States and people age 15 or older.
